info.title: NSG MES API
info.description:
Placeholder OpenAPI document for the NSG MES backend.

This file is the INPUT to the frontend codegen pipeline (`pnpm gen:api`).
It is intentionally minimal: as of NSG-19 the backend exposes no business
endpoints (see docs/generated/api-routes.md, 0 endpoints). Once the Django +
drf-spectacular backend exists, regenerate this file with
`python manage.py spectacular --file frontend/openapi/schema.json` and re-run
`pnpm gen:api` — DO NOT hand-edit the generated client. NSG-18 (orders) and
NSG-25 (auth) will replace this with the real contract.

get.description: Liveness probe. Trivial, domain-free endpoint used to validate the codegen pipeline end-to-end.
